reviewNotes: Held back: the key signature changes in the score; the solfa keeps one doh. Imported from CCEH tune 001001 (the melody read from 001001a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 1 note off in 22); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. John Bacchus Dykes's dates (1823–1876) are from our page for the tune DIES IRAE (DYKES) (content/hymns/tunes/dies-irae-dykes.json); CCEH's page gives only the year 1868.
